programme.title: Um Traidor Dos Nossos
programme.desc: Um casal de férias em Marraquexe vê-se envolvido nos planos de um oligarca russo para desertar para o ocidente. Entre a mafia russa e os serviços secretos britânicos, o casal é obrigado a fazer uma perigosa viagem por Paris, Berna e pelos cantos mais obscuros da cidade de Londres.

programme.title: Instinto Predador
programme.desc: Um navio grego transporta animais exóticos perigosos da Amazónia, incluindo um raro jaguar branco. Nessa mesma embarcação, um assassino, que estava a ser extraditado em segredo para os EUA, consegue fugir e libertar todos os animais em cativeiro, deixando os tripulantes em perigo de vida.

programme.title: Pandemónio
programme.desc: Quando um vírus letal, capaz de tornar as pessoas extremamente violentas e selvagens, se alastra num edifício de escritórios, o advogado Derek Cho e uma cliente insatisfeita terão de unir esforços para lutar pela sobrevivência.

programme.title: True Justice: Travessia Mortífera
programme.desc: Quando um grupo de violentos traficantes de heroína invade as ruas de Seattle, Elijah Kane é chamado a liderar um esquadrão de polícias à paisana, que não vão olhar a meios para pôr um fim ao negócio de droga.

programme.title: True Justice: Condutas Perigosas
programme.desc: A equipa de Elijah Kane tem como missão deter um misterioso assassino de strippers, associado a rituais obscuross, antes deste voltar a cometer mais um crime.

programme.title: O Que Nos Une
programme.desc: Quando Louis, um agente funerário, tem um acidente de viação no qual quase atropela Igor, um jovem deficiente com uma visão muito otimista do mundo, as suas vidas mudarão para sempre... principalmente quando decidem embarcar numa viagem até ao sul de França.

programme.title: Flag Day: Dias Perdidos
programme.desc: Jennifer Vogel tenta superar os destroços do passado ao mesmo tempo que concilia o laço inescapável com o seu pai, que vive uma vida dupla de falsificador, assaltante de bancos e vigarista para a conseguir sustentar.

programme.title: Golpe De Amor
programme.desc: Quando Richard percebe que a sua empresa foi vendida a um empresário fraudulento e que os fundos de pensões de todos os funcionários desapareceram, decide juntar-se à ex-mulher para recuperar o dinheiro, numa aventura pela Europa que envolve perseguições loucas e roubo de joias.

programme.title: Singularidade
programme.desc: Terra 2019, três quartos das famílias têm um robô. O supercomputador Kronos considera os seres humanos a maior ameaça ao planeta e usa os robôs para os matar. Um século depois, poucos humanos restam e a jovem Calia procura o último reduto da humanidade, só que Kronos também.

programme.title: Aeroporto
programme.desc: Mel Bakersfeld é o responsável pelas operações do Aeroporto Internacional de Chicago, que tenta manter em funcionamento durante uma devastadora tempestade de neve, ao mesmo tempo que um bombista suicida ameaça rebentar um Boeing 707 em pleno voo.

programme.title: Yakuza
programme.desc: Harry Kilmer é um detetive norte-americano reformado que regressa ao Japão após décadas de ausência para tentar salvar a filha de um amigo, raptada pela organização criminosa nipónica cujos membros são conhecidos como Yakuza.

programme.title: Arcadian - Invasão Sombria
programme.desc: Num futuro em que maioria da civilização foi dizimada por um pandemia, Paul e os seus filhos gémeos lutam pela sobrevivência numa quinta fortificada.

programme.title: 21 Pontes
programme.desc: Andre Davis é um detetive da polícia de Nova Iorque que tem de capturar os responsáveis pelas mortes de vários colegas, numa operação-limite onde são fechadas as 21 pontes de Manhattan para impedir a fuga dos assassinos da ilha.

programme.title: Um Dia De Chuva Em Nova Iorque
programme.desc: Gatsby e Ashleigh são um casal de estudantes de faculdade que passam um fim-de-semana a visitar Nova Iorque, onde ela tem a tarefa de entrevistar um realizador de cinema para o jornal da universidade e onde ambos vão viver várias aventuras que vão provocar um sério abalo na sua relação.

programme.title: O Torneio
programme.desc: Numa cidade no norte de Inglaterra, um torneio é assistido por dezenas de homens ricos, com 30 concorrentes que estão dispostos a tudo para ganhar um prémio de 10 milhões de dólares. O objetivo é simples: matar todos os adversários e ser o último sobrevivente de todos.

programme.title: Domino - A Hora Da Vingança
programme.desc: Um polícia de Copenhaga procura fazer justiça pela morte de um colega que foi assassinado por um homem misterioso.

programme.title: Joe
programme.desc: O atormentado Joe Ransom tenta esquecer o seu passado turbulento levando uma vida tranquila numa pequena cidade do Texas, onde conhece Gary, um rapaz de 15 anos, de quem acaba por tornar-se mentor e que acaba por defender de um pai violento e abusivo.

programme.title: True Justice: Guerras De Rua
programme.desc: Elijah Kane e a sua equipa entram em ação depois de ocorrerem várias mortes na área de Seattle, relacionadas com um novo tipo de ecstasy. Kane inicia este trabalho infiltrado como segurança de uma equipa que filma um documentário.

programme.title: True Justice: Droga Assassina
programme.desc: Elijah Kane comanda uma equipa de polícias à paisana em Seattle que procura grandes criminosos, derrotando-os pela justiça bruta de rua. Kane, embora admirável, possui um passado rodeado de mistério.

programme.title: Ursinho Procura-Se
programme.desc: Michel perdeu o ursinho de peluche da filha no aeroporto de Roissy e é contactado por alguém que o afirma ter encontrado e que reclama a recompensa. Só que o caminho para chegar ao brinquedo vai ser tudo menos fácil.

programme.title: Rock'n Roll
programme.desc: Uma jovem atriz chama à realidade o seu colega Guillaume Canet durante a rodagem de um filme, dizendo-lhe que ele deixou de ser um sex-symbol desde que se acomodou à vida doméstica com Marion Cotillard. Agora ele vai ter de reaver a sua imagem e provar que ainda é uma estrela rock´n roll.

programme.title: Alguém Tem Que Ceder
programme.desc: Harry Langer é um homem de meia idade que tem namoradas muito mais jovens mas que, quando tem um ataque cardíaco, acaba por ficar ao cuidado de Erica, a mãe da sua última namorada-troféu. Só que embora inicialmente eles se detestem, o inesperado acaba por acontecer…

programme.title: Cidade Fatal
programme.desc: Um ex-polícia desacreditado é obrigado a trabalhar para um implacável líder do crime para pagar a dívida do seu pai e proteger a sua família.

programme.title: Serenidade
programme.desc: O passado misterioso do comandante de um navio de pesca regressa para o assombrar quando a sua ex-mulher insiste em abordá-lo com um desesperado pedido de ajuda, enredando a sua vida numa nova dimensão em que nada é o que parece.

programme.title: A Linha Do Horizonte
programme.desc: O piloto de um pequeno avião tem um ataque cardíaco em pleno voo rumo a uma ilha tropical. Para salvarem as suas vidas, Sara e Jackson, um casal de ex-namorados, terão de conseguir manter a aeronave no ar e encontrar o caminho de regresso a terra…

programme.title: Réplicas
programme.desc: William Foster é um neurocientista genial cuja mulher e os três filhos morrem num acidente de carro. Secretamente, ele vai tentar clonar os seus corpos criando réplicas, mas vai ter de fazer uma escolha radical: ele só consegue trazer três dos seus quatro familiares de volta à vida.

programme.title: O Duelo
programme.desc: Em 1887, no Oeste americano, um Texas Ranger investiga uma série de mortes por explicar numa cidade chamada Helena.

programme.title: Medida Provisória
programme.desc: Num futuro distópico, o governo brasileiro decreta uma medida provisória que obriga os cidadãos negros a “regressarem” a África, como forma de reparar os erros cometidos na era da escravatura, o que provoca o caos, protestos e um movimento de resistência que vai inspirar a nação.

programme.title: Vendeta
programme.desc: Três amigos casados reúnem-se para um encontro anual de caça numa zona de deserto mas um deles traz consigo a jovem amante e a situação fica rapidamente fora de controlo. Deixada como morta no meio de um deserto infernal, a rapariga vai vingar-se e caçá-los um a um...

programme.title: Emboscada
programme.desc: Durante a guerra do Vietname, um grupo de comandos de elite americanos, liderados pelo Capitão Drummond, são encarregues de recolher informação altamente confidencial numa missão arriscada que poderá mudar por completo o rumo do conflito.

programme.title: O Uivo
programme.desc: Numa noite de tempestade, o último comboio de Londres trava de emergência numa floresta. O maquinista sai para investigar e desaparece, os passageiros ficam em pânico ao ouvirem uivos vindos da escuridão e há uma criatura à solta que obriga a que todos se juntem para sobreviver.

programme.title: True Justice: Alianças Criminosas
programme.desc: Elijah Kane conta com o apoio da sua equipa de especialistas para tentar deter os Yakuza, uma perigosa organização criminal, ao mesmo tempo que é forçado a lidar com um caso de reféns inocentes.

programme.title: True Justice: Operações Encobertas
programme.desc: O passado como militar nas operações especiais volta a assombrar o agente Elijah Kane, encarregue de investigar um violador em série e ainda um caso de contrabando de diamantes, comandado por um grupo de russos recém-chegados à cidade.

programme.title: As Coisas Que Dizemos, As Coisas Que Fazemos
programme.desc: Daphne, grávida de três meses, está de férias no campo e enquanto espera que o seu companheiro François, ausente em trabalho, vá ter com ela, vai-se aproximando de Maxime, um primo que nunca conhecera e de quem vai ficando cada vez mais íntima.

programme.title: Altamira
programme.desc: Em 1879, Marcelino, que vive na comunidade espanhola de Cantábria, descobre uma caverna com pinturas rupestres do Paleolítico Superior, mas vai ter de provar que elas são verídicas quando a Igreja Católica o quer desacreditar por perceber que elas ameaçam aquilo que é descrito na Bíblia.

programme.title: Mulher De Ouro
programme.desc: Maria Altmann, uma octogenária judia austríaca refugiada nos EUA, não se vai deter perante nada para recuperar os bens da sua família apreendidos pelos nazis, entre eles um famoso quadro de Gustav Klimt, missão em que será ajudada por um corajoso mas inexperiente advogado.

programme.title: Negócios De Ocasião
programme.desc: O proprietário de uma pequena empresa e os seus dois sócios viajam para a Europa para fecharem o negócio mais importante das suas vidas. Mas o que começou como uma viagem de negócios vai sair fora dos carris, incluindo escalas não programadas…

programme.title: Derradeira Viagem
programme.desc: Trinta anos depois de servirem juntos no Vietname, um antigo enfermeiro da Marinha, “Doc” Larry Shepherd, reúne-se com dois velhos amigos e antigos fuzileiros, Sal Nealon e o agora Reverendo Richard Mueller, para juntos enterrarem o seu filho, um jovem fuzileiro naval morto na guerra do Iraque.

programme.title: Fora de Controlo
programme.desc: Thomas Craven é um veterano da polícia que investiga o homicídio da própria filha, na sequência do qual descobre uma conspiração empresarial e governamental de proporções inesperadas.

programme.title: Beethoven - Fidelio, Op. 72
programme.desc: Fidelio (originally titled 'Leonore, oder Der Triumph der ehelichen Liebe,' which translates to 'Leonore, or the Triumph of Marital Love'), Op. 72, is Ludwig van Beethoven's only opera. This 2018 opera film from the Swiss Theater St. Gallen is based on Jan Schmidt-Garre's highly acclaimed stage production of Beethoven's Fidelio. Otto Tausk conducts the Sinfonieorchester and choir of St.

programme.title: Waldbühne 2000 - Rhythm and Dance
programme.desc: The annual summer concert given by the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra at the Waldbühne is a legendary event. The Millenium concert, recorded live on June 25, 2000, brought together more than 22,000 spectators in one of Europe's most beautiful outdoor amphitheaters.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 38, K. 504
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek’s only symphony – was never performed during the composer’s lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Debussy, Haydn a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Isabel Weller (Germany, 1994) and pianist Yuriko Watanabe (Japan, 1994) perform Claude Debussy’s Nuit d’étoiles, L. 2, and Mandoline, L. 43; Joseph Haydn’s Piercing eyes, Hob. XXVIa, No. 35; ‘Die Mainacht’ from Johannes Brahms’s Vier Gesänge, Op. 43; ‘Pietà’ from Paul Hindemith’s Das Marienleben, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Septet in E-flat major - Opus 20
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is an orchestra based in Berlin, Germany and is ranked as one of the best orchestras in the world. In 1991, orchestra members played beautiful chamber music, such as Beethoven’s Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20. Beethoven finished his septet in 1800 and dedicated his work to Empress Maria Theresa of Naples and Sicily.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 35
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 in D Major, K. 385, recorded at the Nieuwe Kerk, The Hague, in 2020. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 is also known as the “Haffner Symphony”.

programme.title: Grieg's Piano Concerto And Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn’s concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Diepenbrock, Fauré a. o.
programme.desc: Tenor Zhuohan Sun (China, 1993) and pianist Sara Pavlovic (Serbia, 1996) perform ‘Wanderlied’ from Robert Schumann’s Kerner-Lieder, Op. 35; ‘Der Abend kommt gezogen’ from Alphons Diepenbrock’s Drie ballades, Op. 1; Gabriel Fauré’s Prison, Op. 83, No. 1; ‘Ganymed’ from Hugo Wolf’s Goethe-Lieder; Franz Schubert’s Nacht und Träume, D. 827; Zaiyi Lu’s The bridge in my homeland; ‘Mit Myrten und Rosen’ from Schumann’s Liederkreis, Op.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Beethoven No. 5
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Ludwig van Beethoven’s ‘Symphony No. 5’ is discussed.

programme.title: Liszt - Totentanz, S. 525
programme.desc: Russian pianist Dina Ivanova performs Franz Liszt’s Totentanz, S. 525, during the Solo finals of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held at TivoliVredenburg in Utrecht, the Netherlands. Totentanz (Dance of Death) is one of Liszt’s many works that reflect the Romantic composer’s fascination with death. The piece is a series of variations on the macabre Gregorian Dies irae theme.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: 'It would be hard to find anything greater, more significant or more moving anywhere in musical life today: total harmony of mind and heart, poetry and outcry, fear and consolation, knowing and feeling,' declared the Berne paper Der Bund after this stunning performance of Mahler's Resurrection Symphony in August 2003 by the newly founded Lucerne Festival Orchestra.

programme.title: Roberto Giordano plays Brahms and Beethoven
programme.desc: In this recital, Roberto Giordano plays the Six Pieces for Piano, op. 118 of Brahms, a collection completed in 1893 and dedicated to Clara Schumann who will be the penultimate produced by the composer during his lifetime. The concert program also includes two Beethoven sonatas, the famous Moonlight Sonata No. 14, op. 27, and Sonata No. 31, op. 110, one of the last sonatas signed by the composer.

programme.title: Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Chamber Music by Mozart and Von Dohnányi
programme.desc: The Valerius Ensemble, consisting of Carola Ligt (flute), Robert Windak (violin), Eva Šušlíková (viola) and René Geesing (cello) played a concert in Concordia, Enschede on April 23, 2018. The program consists of Mozarts Flute Quartet No. 1, K. 285 and the Romanzo from Von Dohnányi’s Serenade Op. 10. Caroli Ligt follows with her own composition “Moods.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Intro and Rondo Capriccioso, Op. 28
programme.desc: The Waldbühne in Berlin, one of the most appealing outdoor amphitheatres on the European continent, is the home of the Berliner Philharmoniker’s summer concerts. With over 22.000 in attendance, they are some of the most popular classical music concerts in the world.

programme.title: Between Church and Theatre: Jommelli and Scarlatti
programme.desc: To strengthen faith and stimulate piety: this was the role of music according to Pope Benedictus XIV, who in the 18th century carried out radical church reforms. Festival resident Giulio Prandi closely examines the religious repertoire of this period from a double perspective: that of traditional counterpoint, as in Domenico Scarlatti’s ‘Madrid’ Mass, and that of the modern, theatrical style of Perez and Jommelli.

programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta.

programme.title: Brahms - A German Requiem, Op. 45
programme.desc: In this concert recorded in November 2016 at the magnificent Baroque basilica of Saint Florian, Austria – once the home of Anton Bruckner – the Wiener Singverein, the Cleveland Orchestra and its principal conductor Franz Welser-Möst pare down all traces of bombast wherever emotions could easily run out of control. Brahms' Ein Deutsches Requiem, Op.

programme.title: Riccardo Chailly conducts Mendelssohn
programme.desc: Riccardo Chailly’s inaugural concert as Kapellmeister of the Leipzig Gewandhaus Orchestra captures the full atmosphere of a unique musical occasion. The concert centers round composer Felix Mendelssohn, who founded the Gewandhaus Orchestra in 1743. It includes an overwhelming performance of Mendelssohn’s Symphony No.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Elias Ackerley
programme.desc: Pianist Elias Ackerley (United Kingdom/South Korea, 2001) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Allegro molto moderato, of Gabriel Fauré’s Piano Quartet No. 1 in C minor, Op. 15.

programme.title: Music of Naples
programme.desc: Throughout the centuries, the Italian city of Naples has proved to have a remarkably favorable climate for artistic innovation. The presence of the royal or vice royal courts, the practice of music in churches, fraternities, and charitable institutions, financial support from well-to-do citizens, and the popularity of song and dance in public life made for an extraordinarily diverse musical landscape.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Jean Paul’s novel ‘Titan’, in which an artistically gifted young man, driven by his failure to find his way in society, eventually commits suicide in despair, inspired Gustav Mahler to compose his Symphony No. 1. The work did not come easily to Mahler: he composed it between 1887 and 1888 when he, in his twenties, was working as a conductor at the Oper Leipzig.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed Symphony No.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Puccini - Madama Butterfly
programme.desc: Italian conductor Beatrice Venezi leads the Orchestre national de Metz Grand Est and the Choeur de l'Opéra-Théâtre de Metz Métropole in a performance of Giacomo Puccini’s tragic opera Madama Butterfly (1904). The story revolves around Cio-Cio-San, the young Japanese geisha ‘Butterfly’ who marries the visiting American officer Pinkerton. Faithfully awaiting his return, she cannot accept that Pinkerton has abandoned her.

programme.title: Silent Night, Holy Night
programme.desc: This Christmas concert, recorded at the Berlin Schauspielhaus on the Gendarmeriemarkt, was one of the first joint musical productions of reunited Germany. Beautiful visuals of landscapes and other locations in snow and ice turn the concert into a romantic winter storybook. On the program are works by J. S. Bach, G. F. Handel and Prätorius.

programme.title: How to get out of the Cage - A year with John Cage
programme.desc: The compelling documentary How to Get Out of the Cage (2012) by award-winning filmmaker Frank Scheffer presents an intimate portrait of John Cage (1912-1992), one of 20th century's most important composers.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 1 in C minor, Op. 68
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances present Johannes Brahms’s Symphony No. 1 in C minor, Op. 68.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Ives, Brahms a. o.
programme.desc: Bass-baritone Matthias Hoffmann (Austria, 1991) and pianist Lisa Ochsendorf (Germany, 1991) perform ‘A. Very pleasant’ from Charles Ives’s song ‘Memories’; ‘Nachtwanderer’ from Hans Erich Pfitzner’s Fünf Lieder, Op. 7; ‘Nachts’ from Hans Sommer’s Zehn Lieder, Op. 9; ‘Da unten im Tale’ from Johannes Brahms’s Deutsche Volkslieder, WoO.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bach - Works for organ
programme.desc: The Dutch musicologist, conductor, organ and clavecimbel player Ton Koopman specilizes in the performance of Early Music, in particular the music of Johann Sebastian Bach. Although Koopman performs across the globe with his Amsterdam Baroque Orchestra, Koopman is also a sought-after organist. In this broadcast in St.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 5 in A major, K. 219, also known as the ‘Turkish Concerto’. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist.

programme.title: Karl Jenkins - The Armed Man: A Mass for Peace
programme.desc: For this truly unique, historic occasion, Welsh composer Sir Karl Jenkins conducts The World Orchestra for Peace and around 2,000 singers from nearly 30 countries to Sing for Peace at the Berlin's Mercedes Benz Arena on November 2, 2018. Soloists are vocalists Leah-Marian Jones, Yumeji Matsufuji, Pauline Rathmann, Amir Aziz, violinist Krzysztof Wisniewski and cellist Valentino Worlitzsch.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Duparc, Schumann a. o.
programme.desc: Baritone Geng Lee (China, 1994) and pianist Nils Basters (Germany, 1989) perform Henri Duparc’s Chanson triste; ‘Ein Jüngling liebt ein Mädchen’ and ‘Am leuchtenden Sommermorgen’ from Robert Schumann’s Dichterliebe, Op.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final II: Mozart and Bartók
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Carl Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Santtu-Matias Rouvali conducts the Gothenburg Symphony Orchestra and Choir in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Vocal soloists are Ylva Stenberg, Brett Sprague, and Olle Persson. Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Pianomania - Daniil Trifonov
programme.desc: Hannu Lintu conducts the Gulbenkian Orchestra in a Finnish flavoured concert program, since the concert features Cantus Articus, Op. 61 by Einojuhani Rautavaara, and Jean Sibelius’ Symphony No. 2. Furtermore, Daniil Trifonov (1991) is star soloist in Schumann’s Piano Concerto, Op. 54, which was premiered in 1841 by Clara Wieck, wife of the composer.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Mozart - Quintet for piano and winds, K. 452
programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, K. 452. The work premiered at the Viennese Burgtheater on April 1, 1784, with the composer himself at the piano. Shortly after the performance, Mozart wrote to his father Leopold, “I consider it the best work I have ever written…”.

programme.title: De Falla - El sombrero de tres picos - Suite No. 2
programme.desc: During the New Year’s Gala 2010, the Berlin Philharmonic perform under the baton of Gustavo Dudamel, whose infectious energy and exceptional artistry have made him one of the most sought-after conductors by orchestras and opera companies around the world. They welcome mezzo-soprano Elina Garanca, who has become one of the world’s most famous singers within just a few years.

programme.title: IPO 75th Anniversary Gala
programme.desc: Recorded live in Tel Aviv in 2006, this concert honours the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra on its 70th anniversary. With conductor Zubin Mehta and soloists Pinchas Zukerman and Daniel Barenboim, the celebratory concert encompassed artistry far beyond the usual scope of music performance as it presented the brilliant work of many of the musicians most responsible for, and most appreciative of, the orchestra’s rich history.

programme.title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents.

programme.title: Liszt Mosaics- II
programme.desc: This dance concert - performed in the languages of both music and movement - features, in addition to works by Liszt, some of the finest pieces of Hungary's national romanticism that served to inspire them, antecedents of sacred music reaching as far back as the Gregorian period and compositions by contemporaries who influenced Liszt: Paganini and Chopin. Liszt Mosaics is founded on three thematic pillars.

programme.title: Works for violin and piano: Mozart, Beethoven a.o.
programme.desc: On the occasion of International Women’s Day, Italian violinist Laura Marzadori and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti performed a wonderful concert at Teatro Sociale di Camogli, Italy. On the program are Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sonata No. 18 in G major, K. 301; Ludwig van Beethoven’s Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op.

programme.title: Pierre Boulez conducts Modern Classics
programme.desc: Pierre Boulez (1925-2016) was undoubtedly one of the most important figures in modern music.

programme.title: Chopin - Nocturnes Op. 62
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Peter and the Wolf
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Sergei Prokofiev’s Peter and the Wolf, Op. 67. Written in 1936, Peter and the Wolf is a short, narrated orchestral suite, telling the story of a brave boy named Peter, who lives with his grandfather on the edge of a forest.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - The Nutcracker
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's The Nutcracker is one of the best known and most beloved pieces from the composer. The music has inspired many choreographers to the tell the colourful Christmas fairy-tale of E. T. A. Hoffmann and Alexandre Dumas senior in the language of dance. Ben Stevenson is to this day considered one of the most important influencers of the American ballet art.

programme.title: Lang Lang – The Third Dimension
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Lang Lang performs some of the greatest works in the piano repertoire at Berghain in Berlin in 2010. The concert program includes the first movement of Piano Sonata No. 23, op. 57, called Beethoven's Appassionata, the precipato of Prokofiev's Sonata No. 7, and the mention of Iberia (Book 1), the masterpiece of Isaac Albéniz. Lang Lang closes the evening with a powerful version of the ''Heroic'' Polonaise, op.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 5, Op. 18, No. 5
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 3, K. 216
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink starts with Tchaikovsky's Fantasy Overture from 'Roméo et Juliette'. The second piece by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is his famous Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major K.

programme.title: Rossini - La Cenerentola
programme.desc: Gioachino Rossini's opera La Cenerentola ('Cinderella'), with a libretto by Jacopo Ferretti, was first performed in February 1816 following the success of Il Barbiere di Siviglia. Interestingly, much like its predecessor, the first performance of the opera was received with some hostility, but the work soon became popular throughout Italian theaters and beyond.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Russian-born conductor Semyon Bychkov leads the Sinfonieorchester Köln in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s Das Lied von der Erde (‘The Song of the Earth’, 1908). Mezzo-soprano Waltraud Meier and tenor Torsten Kerl star as the soloists in this performance, recorded at the Kölner Philharmonie, Germany, 2001. Das Lied von der Erde is an orchestral song cycle for two voices and a large orchestra.

programme.title: My heart is burning
programme.desc: René Pape perfectly embodies the new generation of opera singers: with a current and relaxed appearance, he craves new challenges and demonstrates an openness to ambitious experimentation. In the musical film My Heart Is Burning, René Pape sings and plays various roles that showcase the impressive versatility of his voice and the many facets of his personality. Directed by Sibylle Muth.

programme.title: Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Finzi, Duparc a. o.
programme.desc: Tenor Ilja Aksionov (Lithuania, 1996) and pianist Gustas Raudonius (Lithuania, 1996) perform Bart Visman’s Het goud van Vermeer; ‘As I lay in the early sun’ from Gerald Finzi’s Oh fair to see, Op. 13b; Henri Duparc’s Extase; Claude Debussy’s Paysage sentimental, L. 55; ‘Mausfallensprüchlein’ from Hugo Wolf’s Sechs Lieder; ‘Krysolov’ (The pied piper) from Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Six Romances, Op. 38; Franz Schubert’s Rastlose Liebe, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Rolando Villazón - One Night in Berlin
programme.desc: French-Mexican tenor Rolando Villazón (1972) is accompanied by the Südwestdeutsche Kammerphilharmonie Konstanz in performing a colourful recital from the Berliner Philharmonie. In this concert from 2006, Villazón performs various arias by Italian opera composers like Verdi, Rossini, Donizetti, Cilea and Mascagni. On the program are also some French works by Massenet, like Ô Souverain, ô juge, ô père from Le Cid and Toute mon âme est là!

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Bach - Goldberg Variations (BWV 988)
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations.

programme.title: Telemann - Jesus liegt in letzten Zügen, TWV 1:983
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries.

programme.title: Summertime at the Domaine Forget
programme.desc: The documentary Summertime at the Domaine Forget introduces internationally renowned treasure: Domaine Forget festival in Saint-Irénée, Québec. Domaine Forget is one of Canada's leading music academies and hosts this annual festival to promote music and dance.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 4, Op. 40
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in this powerful performance taken from the 150th Anniversary celebrations of Denmark’s national composer, Carl Nielsen. Alongside Nielsen’s inscrutably ironic Symphony No. 6, this performance features world-renowned French pianist Lise de la Salle as soloist in Rachmaninov’s Piano Concerto No. 4.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 3 BWV 1016
programme.desc: Johann Sebastian Bach’s Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No. 3 BWV 1016 belongs to a group of sonatas composed before 1975, probably during the composer’s tenure as Kapellmeister at Köthen. He presumably wrote these sonata’s for Prince Leopold, later adapting them for his own purposes in Leipzig.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: In September 2016, we celebrated the birthday of one of Japan's best-known conductors: Seiji Ozawa. Renowned for his advocacy of modern composers, Ozawa founded the Saito Kinen Festival Matsumoto in 1992. As of 2015, it is better known as the Seiji Ozawa Festival. Seiji Ozawa appeared on stage himself with 63 Saito Kinen Orchestra members, passionately conducting Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 and No. 7.

programme.title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final: Rameau, Liszt and Chopin
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Giaches de Wert: From Ghent via Naples to the Top
programme.desc: Palestrina and Monteverdi were fans. The Gonzagas and the d’Estes were his employers. And the Marchioness of Padulla was his Neapolitan patroness. Thanks to his talents, Giaches De Wert moved from the region around Ghent where he was born to work in some of the most important Italian centres of Renaissance polyphony. He developed into an international star. The Belgian vocal ensemble Utopia sings his motets and Missa dominicalis.

programme.title: Baroque choral music by Bach, Schütz et al.
programme.desc: Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig’s St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes sacred madrigals by Johann Hermann Schein, motets from Heinrich Schütz’s collection Geistliche Chor-Music, as well as two motets by the most famous Thomaskantor: Johann Sebastian Bach.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Bernhard Haitink conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1. Directed by Barry Gavin, this concert took place at the Berliner Philharmonie in 1992. Mahler was inspired by Jean Paul’s novel Titan, in which an artistically gifted young man, driven by his failure to find his way in society, eventually commits suicide in despair.

programme.title: Waldbühne 2004 - Tchaikovsky night
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker and Lang Lang under the baton of Sir Simon Rattle.

programme.title: Pé Em Riste - Ep. 24
programme.desc: A jornada analisada de Pé em Riste por um painel que junta os mais polémicos e incisivos adeptos do Benfica, Sporting e Porto.

programme.title: Jornal Da Meia-Noite
programme.desc: Cobertura intensiva da atualidade, em direto, com reportagem e análise da atualidade e dos exclusivos com a marca da CMTV.

programme.title: Noite Das Estrelas
programme.desc: Noite das Estrelas é um late show como nunca se fez no País apresentado por Maya que analisam os temas palpitantes do mundo social e cor-de-rosa, com a ajuda de um painel de luxo que conta com Teresa Guilherme, Daniel Nascimento, Adriano Silva Martins, Gisela Serrano e Duarte Siopa.

programme.title: Jornal Da Meia-Noite
programme.desc: Cobertura intensiva da atualidade, em direto, com reportagem e análise da atualidade e dos exclusivos com a marca da CMTV.

programme.title: Notícias CM
programme.desc: Síntese das principais notícias, em direto da redação do Correio da Manhã.

programme.title: Entre Pernas
programme.desc: Os dois encontram-se pela primeira vez numa reunião de grupo para viciados em sexo. Ela é Miranda, redatora de um programa de rádio noturno e que se aproveita, nos seus passeios matinais como o cão para ter encontros sexuais com todo o tipo de homens. Ele é Javier, talentoso roteirista e produtor de cinema, que está preso a uma relação doentia, por telefone, com uma mulher misteriosa que lhe conta as suas aventuras sexuais.

programme.desc: O programa “Manhã Viva” surge com o objetivo de levar aos telespectadores conteúdos e temas diversificados, que abordem a atualidade, as tradições nacionais, a cultura portuguesa, trazendo à conversa alguns temas sobre a sociedade e, ao mesmo tempo, dando a conhecer algumas personalidades que acrescentem valor e conhecimento aos telespectadores.

programme.title: Adoração Ao Santíssimo Sacramento
programme.desc: A Adoração ao Santíssimo Sacramento é um momento de profunda intimidade com Deus. Procura-se a reconciliação, reavivando a fé e possibilitando uma transformação para uma nova vida.

programme.title: Biblia No Meu Dia A Dia - 1ª Exibição
programme.desc: A Palavra de Deus, materializada nos livros da Bíblia, é uma dádiva para toda a humanidade, e para cada um de nós, de uma forma muito especial. Contudo, a fim de crescermos em amor em relação à Palavra, é preciso treino e persistência.

programme.title: Santa Missa
programme.desc: A Santa Missa é o ponto mais alto da vida de oração de todo cristão. É a principal celebração dos cristãos católicos, com o objetivo de levar a celebração Eucarística a todos, principalmente, para as regiões do país que não têm celebrações frequentes.

programme.title: Sorrindo Pra Vida
programme.desc: Proposta de começar bem a tarde com ânimo, bom humor e esperança.

programme.desc: Oração rezada no Santuário do Pai das Misericórdias, em Cachoeira Paulista, São Paulo, sede da Comunicação Canção Nova.

programme.title: Quinta-Feira De Adoração
programme.desc: Todas as quintas, durante o dia, o fiel tem a oportunidade de viver uma experiência de profunda intimidade com Jesus Cristo.

programme.title: Feira Semanal: Nazaré
programme.desc: Na Nazaré, a feira mistura-se com o vento, sal e com o som do mar. É uma extensão da vida piscatória, mas também uma celebração da terra e da fé. Aqui a feira não é só comércio — é mar e monte, fé e sustento, é história a acontecer à sombra dos toldos e ao som do pregão. Aqui, tudo tem cor: os sapatos as vozes, as saias das mulheres que vendem com orgulho e graça. As vozes são firmes, as saias são sete.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele T5 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Os dois sobreviventes têm de passar 21 dias sem comida, água ou roupa num dos lugares mais rigorosos e remotos do mundo. Como é que se vão sair?

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele T5 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Quando um terceiro sobrevivente entra no concurso sem convite, a tensão e o ciúme são tão ameaçadores como o calor, as piranhas e os jaguares da floresta equatorial do Equador.

programme.title: Fast N' Loud (Velozes E Ruidosos) T5 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: O plano de Richard para revelar o 'Krew Kut' Dually no Lone Star Throwdown enfrenta um problema. Sem tejadilho no carro, a chuva pesada obriga a equipa a mudar de planos.

programme.title: Fast N' Loud (Velozes E Ruidosos) T5 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Por todo o estado do Texas, Richard Rawlings procura carros clássicos esquecidos e negligenciados para comprar e restaurar na Gas Monkey Garage, em Dallas.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas: Carros De Sonho T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Desde o Maserati ao Audi R8, do Morgan Aero Coupe ao Porsche 911, esta é uma viagem ao paraíso automóvel para saber como estas máquinas são desenhadas e criadas.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas: Carros De Sonho T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: O seu carro de sonho parece-se com o Morgan Three-Wheeler? A equipa vai à sua origem em Inglaterra onde são examinadas as funcionalidades e o seu deslumbrante exterior.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T15 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Mike Brewer e o multifacetado mecânico Ant Anstead têm como missão encontrar e restaurar carros icónicos que mais tarde vendem na sua oficina de Los Angeles.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T15 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: Mike Brewer e o multifacetado mecânico Ant Anstead têm como missão encontrar e restaurar carros icónicos que mais tarde vendem na sua oficina de Los Angeles.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Os Dakota Boys têm dificuldades em gerir as suas duas dragas até à chegada de Casey Morgan. Mas rapidamente ficam com menos um homem quando um membro da equipa se queima.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Os Dakota Boys são perseguidos por ursos famintos. As duas dragas de Dustin estão a todo o gás, mas quando põem a trabalhar um segundo sistema de guincho o desastre acontece.

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T8 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: O ajuntamento do gado sofre uma reviravolta quando um cavalo fica preso nos arames elétricos. Atz Sr. leva Bonnie numa caçada épica.

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T8 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Sempre levados ao limite pelos elementos, circunstâncias e uns pelos outros, os Kilcher continuam a trabalhar juntos enquanto família para manterem a rica herança da propriedade.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T16 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Kevin recua quando Parker chega para receber. Parker descobre que uma instalação de lavagem perde ouro. Mike põe recrutas no campo de treino.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T16 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Os incêndios ameaçam fechar uma das concessões de Parker. Rick decide se volta a Vegas Valley. Tony perde muito dinheiro com a instalação de lavagem.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T16 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Parker lança o caos para pôr 4 fábricas a funcionar pela primeira vez. Tony compra uma nova fábrica e Rick começa a trabalhar em Vegas Valley.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T18 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Mais objetos são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como as cordas de ferro industriais, paredes vivas e câmaras de grande formato são feitas.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T18 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Saiba como as moedas de chocolate, os carros a pedais e as espadas de látex são feitos neste episódio da popular série.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T18 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Mais itens do quotidiano são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como os casacos de motard e as pás são feitos. Vemos ainda como se produz o caviar de viveiro.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T18 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Saiba como as figuras de cera, os toldos, bolachas de água e sal e as canecas de peltre são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T18 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Mais itens do quotidiano são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como os escovilhões, o queijo Stilton, os medidores elétricos e os telescópios são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T18 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Réplicas de peixe, sistemas de alarme, sandes empacotadas e velas são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrem como são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T18 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Mais itens do quotidiano são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como os doces de tapioca, os limpa neves, os barcos de paddle e a fibra de cimento são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T18 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Saiba como os carros de rally, as tartes de porco, as fontes flutuantes e os ornamentos de pedra artificial são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T26 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são vistos ao microscópio, revelando a sua produção. Como são feitos objetos como os giroscópios?

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Nick, escultor de belas artes, tem de ser extra cauteloso quando usa um berbequim para restaurar uma urna do século XIX. Jolene, especialista em iluminação, é desafiada por Drew.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T10 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Numa fábrica de tecidos de luxo em Suffolk, Drew fica deslumbrado com as capacidades históricas usadas na casa real. Num castelo na Escócia, regateia com um jovem barão.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T10 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Num igreja católica em Liverpool, as preces de Drew são ouvidas com um par de cadeiras raras. Em Loughborough, encontra pérolas industriais na maior fundição de sinos do mundo.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T10 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Drew regateia forte e feio equipamento de quinta vintage em Exmouth. Depois, fica empolgado com uma fantástica coleção de mobília de artesanato - mas conseguirá fazer negócio?

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters T9 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: O acampamento YMCA do Maine quer mais casas de banho, um beliche, um galinheiro e uma área para barbecue. A equipa trabalha durante o inverno para concluir as obras antes do verão.

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters T9 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Um homem que herdou recentemente o retiro de inverno do pai quer honrar a memória deste e, ao mesmo tempo, tornar o acampamento confortável para a família e os seus Corgis.

programme.title: Restauradores Ao Resgate T11 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: A equipa concentra-se em recuperar artigos de uma loja de equipamento desportivo em Largo, Maryland. Depois, reutilizam uma caixa de equipamento velho da quinta.

programme.title: Restauradores Ao Resgate T11 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: A equipa recupera artigos de uma mansão em Livingston, Nova Jérsia. Esta casa histórica desafia a equipa com nuances de design invulgares e caraterísticas bem definidas.

programme.title: Restauradores De Casas De Campo: A Construir Em Itália T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Chase e a família assumem o projeto mais ambicioso de Balcony House, transformando os antigos estábulos numa nova sala de estar para a família.

programme.title: Restauradores De Casas De Campo: A Construir Em Itália T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Com muito trabalho pela frente e só duas semanas, Chase corre para acabar exteriores, telhados, decks, paisagismo e mais!

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T5 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: O pintor, Gill, traz o romance de volta a um armário de casamento chinês desbotado. O especialista em couro, Martin, salva uma mala rara que é uma das melhores que já viu.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T5 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: O carpinteiro, Steve, conta restaurar uma arca antiga com fogo. Será que se transforma em cinzas? Além disso, um perito em iluminação trata de um candelabro de art déco exclusivo.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele T5 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Num glaciar do Alasca, os sobreviventes da equipa, Laura e Steven, evitam as queimaduras de frio e a hipotermia. O instinto de sobrevivência e as capacidades são postos à prova.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele T5 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Na floresta tropical das Honduras, um sobrevivente e um detetive teimoso tentam dar-se bem durante 21 dias. Jaguares, formigas vermelhas e uma lesão debilitante podem impedi-los.

programme.title: Fast N' Loud (Velozes E Ruidosos) T5 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Com o prazo a chegar ao fim, os Monkeys enfrentam um dilema mecânico quando não conseguem encaixar o motor flat head de 1950 na sua carrinha Ford de 1933.

programme.title: Fast N' Loud (Velozes E Ruidosos) T5 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Richard e os Gas Monkeys mergulham no mundo das corridas de stock cars da NASCAR. Eles transformam um Chevy Coupe de 52 num monstro destinado a vencer nas pistas.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas: Carros De Sonho T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Junte-se à equipa e explore as origens, o berço, o funcionamento e as especificações técnicas de alguns dos melhores carros do mundo.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas: Carros De Sonho T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Alguma vez se perguntou como o Ginetta G40 é feito? Junte-se à equipa de 'O Segredo das Coisas' enquanto conhece a sua origem, revelando as funcionalidades e linhas exteriores.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T15 - Ep. 22
programme.desc: Mike localiza um Chevy C10 de '71. Está em excelentes condições, mas ele sente que poderiam maximizar o seu lucro se o tornassem mais 'conduzível'.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T15 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Mike encontra um Fiat 124 Spider de 1972 que precisa de uma melhoria na sua condução. Mike deita as mãos ao trabalho no interior, enquanto Ant arranja o diferencial.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Fred e Dustin descordam sobre onde encontrar ouro e escavam buracos separados. Mas um sério confronto ameaça toda a operação.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Os Dakota Boys e a equipa enfrentam dificuldades e atrasos quando o equipamento se avaria. Mas o trabalho árduo finalmente compensa quando encontram uma grande quantidade de ouro.

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T8 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Sempre levados ao limite pelos elementos, circunstâncias e uns pelos outros, os Kilcher continuam a trabalhar juntos enquanto família para manterem a rica herança da propriedade.

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T9 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Levados ao limite pelos elementos, pelas circunstâncias e uns pelos outros, a família Kilcher continua a trabalhar em conjunto para manter a valiosa herança da propriedade.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T16 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Rick sai vitorioso em Vegas Valley. A campanha de Parker nas 4 fábricas esbarra. Para continuar em maré de sorte, Tony rouba mais equipamento de Mike.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T16 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Parker tenta travar a queda do ouro, Rick faz uma descoberta que pode acabar com os sonhos em Vegas Valley e Kevin ganha muito dinheiro no Sphinx Cut.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T16 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Rick pede 1 milhão de dólares para uma nova operação. Parker encarrega Brennan de entregar mais ouro. Tony altera o sistema de água de Paradise Hill.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T16 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: A equipa de Tony é transferida para a de Parker, ficando com operadores inexperientes. Os contratados dão mau ambiente na abertura da nova operação.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T18 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Saiba como os botões de punho, folhados de mirtilo, tabliers e a louça de barro são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T18 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Mais objetos quotidianos são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como são feitos os blisters dos medicamentos, as fatiadoras e os cataventos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T18 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Chapéus-coco, painéis solares, bolinhos e colunas electroestáticas são vistos ao microscópio.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T18 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Mais objetos quotidianos são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como são feitos as mesas de mistura, equipamento de parques infantis e frigideiras antiaderentes.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T19 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Como se fazem os ancinhos, o caramelo inglês, postais e as formas Bundt? Saiba tudo enquanto analisamos estes objetos ao microscópio.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T19 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Como fazem os cantis de inox, salada de batata, células de hidrogénio e revestimento de madeira? Saiba tudo enquanto analisamos estes objetos ao microscópio.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T19 - Ep. 3

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 19
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 53
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Salif Keita And Les Ambassadeurs
programme.desc: Salif Keita’s music is a rich combination of traditional Malian music with European and American influences. We can hear this in the instrumentation of Keita’s music, which varies from traditional West-African instruments to Western European ones. The Malian singer was cast out by his family because of his albinism. In 1967 he moved to Bamako, where he started his musical career and joined Les Ambassadeurs (Internationaux).

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Earl Hines Quartet in Spa, 1977
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.

programme.title: A$AP Rocky And A$AP Ferg - At The Hordern Pavilion
programme.desc: Big hits, booty dancing, stage dives, fan freestyles and of course, controversy, A$AP Rocky's debut Down Under tour had it all! At his sold-out Sydney show, hip hop's hottest star and 5000 rowdy fans got wild for the night at the Hordern Pavilion and we captured it all exclusively.

programme.title: Michelle David - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Sienna Jazz
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Skylark
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, smooth jazz saxophonist and crowd-favorite Kenny G serenaded those attending the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Os Capoeira.

programme.desc: The NYC band Lucky Chops rose to fame when a video of their performance at a subway station went viral on YouTube in 2015. Since then, the energetic quintet has been entertaining audiences all over the world. The band was formed in 2006, when trumpeter Joshua Gawel, saxophonist Daro Behroozi, trombonist Josh Holcomb, tubist Raphael Buyo, and drummer Charles Sams, met during their education at Fiorello H.

programme.desc: Legendary free jazz pianist Burton Greene rose to fame in New York City's free jazz scene of the 1960s. Exploring various spontaneous improvisational styles, Greene performs live at Cafe OTO in London, UK.

programme.title: The Good Times
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: The Jasmin Tree
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre.

programme.title: J.E. 'Cannonball' Adderley live in Switzerland

programme.title: Caetano Veloso, Aquele Frevo Axe
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: VIVA!
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. “Viva” is a perfect mixture of various instruments and musicians from all over the world.

programme.title: Wynton in the South Bank Show
programme.desc: Considered one of the most technically brilliant players in the history of the trumpet, jazz musician Wynton Marsalis is also a master of classical music and a fine composer. Marsalis takes the cameras with him around New York, to his home town of New Orleans, and to his rehearsal studios where he and his assembled band of musicians are seen putting together the album Blood on the Fields.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko And Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: Face au Public: Chuck Berry
programme.desc: No early breakthrough rock And roll artist is more important to the development of the genre than Chuck Berry (1926-2017). Influenced by jazz and rhythm and blues, he was rock And roll's greatest songwriter, the main shaper of its instrumental voice, one of its greatest guitarists, and one of its greatest performers.

programme.title: Horace Silver - Song for my father
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964.

programme.title: Edina Mokus - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Thomas Carbou: Spectacle Au Bleury
programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Patrick Graham share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes.

programme.title: Louis 'Satchmo' Armstrong and His All Stars
programme.desc: Louis Armstrong: Live in '59 is one of the only known complete Armstrong concerts from the 1950s to be captured on film. This 55-minute set, filmed in Belgium in 1959, features many of Satchmo’s greatest songs including ‘Mack The Knife’, ‘When It’s Sleepy Time Down South’ and ‘Stompin’ At The Savoy,’ backed by his stellar band the All-Stars, featuring Trummy Young, Peanuts Hucko, Billy Kyle, Danny Barcelona and Mort Herbert.

programme.title: Katché And Origlio Quartet feat. Walter Ricci
programme.desc: Four exceptional musicians team up to perform classic pop and soul songs made famous by the likes of Gregory Porter, Stevie Wonder, U2, Seal, and many more. Pianist Alfio Origlio signed up to do the arrangements. Walter Ricci, an accomplished jazz vocalist from Naples, eases us into his musical universe with his stunning sensitivity.

programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. In 2019, one of them is Copenhagen-based Norwegian saxophonist Marius Neset, who is known internationally for his collaborations with People Are Machines, Kaktusch, JazzKamikaze, and Django Bates' projects StoRMChaser and Human Chain.

programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson.

programme.title: Georgie Fame And the Blue Flames
programme.desc: Georgie Fame, known for 'Yeh, Yeh' and 'The Ballad of Bonnie and Clyde' makes a triumphant comeback with The Blue Flames. Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames was a popular band in the UK in the '60s, celebrated for its RAndB, soul, jazz, ska, and pop sounds. The training was largely inspired by ska, a popular musical style in Jamaican cafes in London at the time.

programme.title: Baden Powell Quartet - Jazz Samba
programme.desc: Recorded in 1971 in Paris, France, Brazilian, classically trained bossa nova guitarist Baden Powell and his quartet play Pai, Lotus (written by Baden Powell), Tristeza (by Haroldo Lobo/Niltinho), Round Midnight (by Thelonious Monk), Nega do cabelo duro (by David Nasser/Rubens Soares), and Aos pes da cruz (by Zé da Zilda/Marino Pinto).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Quartet - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1991, Cuban pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Sven Hammond Soul: Tivoli de Helling
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the soundtrack of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: Jack DeJohnette's Special Edition at Estival 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jack DeJohnette, an important figure in jazz fusion, was inducted into the Modern Drummer Hall of Fame in 2007.

programme.title: Visions of Music: Carnet des Routes
programme.desc: Visions of Music - World Jazz invites the viewer on a journey to the roots of music, introducing the enormous impact that traditional music from around the world has had on contemporary jazz. This program features legendary musicians such as BB King, Dino Saluzzi, Tito Puente, Carlos Santana, Zawinul Joe, Manu Dibango, Abdullah Ibrahim, as well as new generation representatives such as Nicholas Payton, Cyro Baptista, and Don Byron.

programme.title: Mr. Phone Bone
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel meets Peter Beets Trio
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Liz McComb in Paris: Back to Blues
programme.desc: This film is a souvenir of an extraordinary concert. It reveals the true personality of Liz Mc Comb: more than a great gospel singer, she is a lover who dreams of sharing her generosity with us. Liz Mc Comb sings, among others, 'I'm Just a Poor Wayfaring Stranger' for all the immigrants in the world, followed by her famous 'Time Is Now'.

programme.title: Ladama - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves’ outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington’s career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world.

This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.
